appName.message: Roomy: Wide Mode for Gemini & ChatGPT

appDesc.message: Widen Gemini and ChatGPT, adjust font size and reading density per site, and pause either site at any time.

localeCode.description: HTML language tag for this translation.

helpOpenPopup.message: Open {sites}, then click the Roomy toolbar icon. On a supported website the popup opens that website's settings; elsewhere it lists all websites.

helpWidthBody.message: Choose px for a fixed width or % to follow the window size. Move the slider or choose a preset. Each website saves width, limits, and presets separately; each unit has its own presets. Expand Range & presets to edit them. The switch beside the width title pauses widening for that website and restores its original width. Your saved values and presets are kept; reading settings remain active.

helpCodeBody.message: Code auto wrap is available on {sites}. Other websites keep their own code-block wrap controls; the extension leaves them unchanged.

helpReadingBody.message: Font size ranges from 75% to 200% without zooming the whole page, keeping headings, code, and tables in proportion. At Auto density 0, native paragraph gaps and line heights are preserved; higher density gradually tightens prose only. Code lines and table cells keep their native line-height proportions, and formulas keep their native spacing. Advanced spacing sets exact manual values; Reset spacing returns to Auto at the current density. Each website keeps separate reading settings.

helpLiveSettings.message: Changes are saved automatically and apply live to open tabs of that website. Each website keeps separate settings; the popup language is shared. Sync across devices depends on your browser’s sync settings.

helpTroubleshootPage.message: Check that you are on a supported website ({sites}) and Roomy is enabled with access to that website. Chrome-installed web apps (PWAs) use the same webpages. Native desktop apps and Chrome’s built-in Gemini panel are not supported.

helpTroubleshootRefresh.message: If a setting does not appear after installing or updating the extension, reload the affected page once. If the popup says the page runs an older version, reload the extension on chrome://extensions first. An unsupported-layout notice means widening is not applied to the current page. Use the switch beside the website name to pause everything on that website; saved settings are kept.

helpTroubleshootReport.message: If the problem continues, note the website, steps to reproduce it, and window size. A screenshot with private content removed can help; mention other extensions that change the page layout.

helpDiagnosticsPrivacy.message: Generate a report to preview before sharing it in an issue. It includes only the extension version, browser name and major version, platform, interface language, and each website's Enable switch, width, range, and reading settings. It contains no chats, page URLs, titles, or custom preset names. Nothing is sent automatically.

helpSupportProject.message: If Roomy helps you, you can star the project or leave an honest review.

helpReportReady.message: Report ready. Review it, then copy it if you want to share it.

helpReportError.message: Could not read settings. Reopen help from the extension and try again.

helpReportCopied.message: Copied. You can paste the report into your issue.

helpReportCopyFallback.message: Copy was unavailable. The report is selected; copy it manually.

taskApplied.message: Applied. Previous settings are saved on this device.

taskSaveError.message: Could not save or load settings. Reopen the popup and try again.

helpTaskBody.message: Choose a task preset, review the summary, then click Apply. Each website offers its own presets, such as Long reading, Wide (tables & code), and Large text. Presets change width, font size, and spacing (and code wrapping where available), within your width limits. Restore previous settings undoes the most recent preset for that website on this device, even after closing the popup; it replaces later changes to those settings.

autoSpacingHint.message: Auto follows each message's native spacing. Moving either slider applies both values below manually.

layoutUnsupported.message: This page layout is not supported yet. Original page width is preserved.

layoutLoading.message: The page is loading. Reopen these settings when it is ready.

layoutUnavailable.message: Page status unavailable. Refresh the page and try again.

saveFailed.message: Could not save. Please try again.

pageOutdated.message: Saved, but this page is still running an older version of the extension. Reload the extension on chrome://extensions, then refresh this page.

taskRestoredClamped.message: Restored. Width adjusted to {width} to fit your current limits.

taskUndoRecordError.message: Applied, but the restore point could not be saved on this device.

taskUndoCleanupError.message: Settings restored, but the restore point could not be cleared. It will be cleaned up next time.

taskPendingUnknown.message: The last task preset did not finish, so restoring is unavailable. Apply a task again to continue.

readingUnsupported.message: Font size and spacing are not applied: this page's message layout is not recognized yet. Width is unaffected.

helpSiteAccess.message: Access to {required} is required. Access to {optional} is optional: click Allow next to the website in the popup's list.

sitePermissionHint.message: {site} access is optional. Allow access to apply these settings.

sitePermissionFailed.message: Could not request access. Please try again.

layoutNotApplicable.message: Roomy does not change this page. Open a conversation to adjust it.
